body.text: SEO services are what Teknoppy has delivered since 2018, and this page is the place to understand exactly what that means before you commit to any agency. As a full-service SEO agency, we combine search engine optimization services with technical fixes, content strategy, and honest reporting — built for businesses that want durable rankings, not a one-month spike that fades.

Whether you run a small clinic, a growing SaaS company, or an established enterprise, our SEO services are built around one idea: organic SEO services should compound over time, not chase algorithm updates every quarter. Most clients see meaningful movement within 3 to 6 months, and the gains keep building from there rather than resetting.
As SEO consulting services, we work with in-house marketing teams, founders, and agencies that need a specialist partner — not a generalist trying to cover everything at once.

sections.h2: What Great SEO Services Actually Include

paragraphs.text: Real SEO services are more than a monthly blog post and a backlink report. They cover SEO strategy and planning, technical SEO audit and fixes, on-page optimization services, content SEO and keyword strategy, website speed and Core Web Vitals fixes, and ongoing link building and authority building — each working together under one SEO management services plan, not sold as disconnected add-ons.

Search behavior keeps splitting across more surfaces than a single Google results page — AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity now answer questions that used to send a click to a website. SEO services in 2026 have to plan for both: rankings in traditional search, and citability in AI-generated answers. A site that only optimizes for the old model is already behind on the newer one, even if last year's tactics still technically "work."

items.a: A complete engagement covers technical SEO, on-page optimization, content and keyword strategy, link building, and monthly reporting — not just one of these sold alone as "SEO."

items.q: How much do SEO services cost?
items.a: Most businesses invest between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 75,000 per month depending on competition and scope; enterprise engagements run higher. A written quote is shared before work starts.

items.q: How long do SEO services take to show results?
items.a: Most clients see meaningful movement within 3 to 6 months, with gains compounding over the following months rather than resetting each cycle.

items.q: How to choose an SEO services company?
items.a: Look for written scope, transparent reporting, real case studies, and a team that can explain its reasoning in plain language — not just promise page-one rankings.

items.q: What is the difference between SEO services and SEO consulting?
items.a: SEO services mean we execute the work directly — audits, fixes, content, links. SEO consulting services mean we advise your existing team on strategy while your staff implements it.

items.q: Which is the best SEO services provider for my business?
items.a: The right fit depends on your industry, budget, and current site health — a best SEO services for businesses answer is rarely one-size-fits-all, which is why every engagement starts with an audit.

items.q: Do SEO services also help with AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity?
items.a: Yes. Alongside traditional Google rankings, we structure content and schema for AEO and GEO, since SEO services that also optimize for AI answer engines are increasingly what separates a modern agency from a legacy one.

items.q: Do you offer SEO services for businesses outside Kerala or India?
items.a: Yes. While Teknoppy is based in Kerala, our SEO services are delivered remotely for clients across India and internationally, with reporting calls scheduled to suit the client's time zone.
